conditions.name: asset_test
conditions.description: Policy says to consider the patient's available assets and all other financial resources; assets defined as banking accounts, cash on hand, CDs, securities, real estate, vehicles, and financial settlements, with supporting documentation required.
conditions.evidence_ref: Page 3: Consider the patient’s available assets and all other financial resources available to the patient.

tiers.evidence_ref: Page 3: Patients whose family income is at or below 200% of the FPL are eligible to receive free care.

tiers.name: Income above 200% and up to 350% of FPL eligible for services at a discount rate; qualifying patients not charged more than AGB. Uninsured patients receive an automatic uninsured discount (facility-specific, 63.64% to 81%).
